content: {"reasoning":"The denial is CO-97, service bundled into another paid service. This is not a medical-necessity issue (already appealed twice on necessity with no change) nor an authorization issue. CO-97 bundling is resolved by correcting the claim, typically with an appropriate modifier to indicate the service is separately payable, then resubmitting. Prior appeals with necessity and records failed because they didn't address the bundling coding issue.","action":"correct_and_resubmit"}
